_meta.title: Shipped baseline seed — illustrative, not released
_meta.purpose: Enough for the product to run and be demonstrated before an operator has released anything. Every value here resolves with provisional: true and is labelled on every screen and in every response that reads it.
_meta.rule: A released baseline replaces this entirely for that metric and scope. The two are never merged.

baselines.source: CarbonIQ FinTech — this product's own carbon-intensity screen, not a taxonomy threshold. The Sri Lanka Green Finance Taxonomy (May 2022) sets no absolute kgCO2e/m² figure: its construction criteria are relative (M6.1 ≥30% PED reduction, M6.3 ≥10% below a nearly zero-energy benchmark) or certification-based (M6.2 Green SL Gold/Platinum).
baselines.note: Two band sets were live in this codebase and disagreed — 520/780 and 600/900 — so a building at 560 kgCO2e/m² was Green from one endpoint and Transition from another. 520/780 is now the single answer, held here so it can be released, versioned and superseded rather than edited in a constants file.
